# Release Notes

## 0.43.0 - 2026-10-20 (deployed)

Environment: production. Deployed SHA `7971839dae4260f21a08f2bd19061d07d06b65b8`, run `39464505710`. MINOR: receipt camera/gallery capture and pending-only scan animation.

PWA photo intake now offers separate rear-camera capture and gallery selection, local preview/replacement with cancellation preservation, and a green scan animation only while recognition is pending. Reduced motion, request locks, HEIC/HEIF and the 10 MiB limit are respected. Recognized data still requires explicit financial confirmation.
